Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The study uses synthetic reporter mRNAs with site-specific nucleotide modifications to compare translation efficiency and accuracy. While these are RNA modifications, the primary biological variable is the engineered sequence/modification state of the mRNA template used for translation in HEK293T cells, which is mapped to genetic perturbation (mutation/variant) as it involves altering the genetic information of the reporter.
